newsitem.title: NORWAY: PGS registers $300 mln in unsecured notes.
newsitem.headline: PGS registers $300 mln in unsecured notes.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services and seismic company Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) said on Tuesday it had filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register $300 million of senior unsecured notes due 2007.

PGS said the net proceeds from the issue would be used to repay about $125 million in provately held senior notes, which were scheduled to begin amortising in 2001, and for general corporate purposes, including the construction of new vessels.
